adds.title: Human Rights Campaign reporting on HB 1108 (2019) / The Transformation Project lawsuit (2024)
adds.summary: On December 16, 2022 South Dakota terminated The Transformation Project's $136,000 federally funded Community Health Worker contract for LGBTQ+/transgender community health in Sioux Falls, and to settle the Project's discrimination lawsuit Health Secretary Melissa Magstadt issued a January 17, 2024 apology letter acknowledging termination and differential treatment versus other Community Health Worker contractors and affirming equal treatment under law regardless of race, colour, national origin, religion, disability, age, or sex, paid $300,000 covering attorney fees, committed not to discriminate against the Project in violation of state or federal law in any services, programs, or activities, and allowed retention of community health worker Jack Fonder.

adds.title: Human Rights Campaign - 2024 Annual State Report
adds.summary: In 2024, Tennessee lacked statewide non-discrimination protections in employment, housing and public accommodations and was among the states most likely to have religious-refusal or other anti-LGBTQ+ laws.
